### [#10943: Menu: after Escape, focus stays in the closing Menu until its exit animation ends](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10943)

- **Problem:** **High severity:** keyboard users can activate an item in an already-closing Menu, potentially navigating unintentionally: "Within 300 ms, press Enter" produces "`Actions: Menu 2: A`".
- **Concerns / notes:** RAC 1.22.1 / hooks 3.53.1 / React 19.3.1; macOS and Linux, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit reported, not the Safari app. A linked StackBlitz and detailed steps are present but were not opened or run. Main keeps Popover mounted while exiting ([Popover.tsx, lines 201-203](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria-components/src/Popover.tsx#L201-L203)); Overlay disables containment during exit but retains `restoreFocus` ([Overlay.tsx, lines 75-80](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria/src/overlays/Overlay.tsx#L75-L80)), whose restoration is in effect cleanup ([FocusScope.tsx, lines 777-801](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria/src/focus/FocusScope.tsx#L777-L801)). This supports investigating close-time focus handling, not a confirmed root cause. No previously working version is supplied, so do not add `regression`.
- **Concerns / notes:** Related, not established duplicates: [#10767](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10767) reports "Nothing is triggered" when closing by outside click, unlike this action firing after Escape; [#10593](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10593) concerns an exiting sibling scope and skipped Tab stops. Keep #10941 and #10942 separate.
- **Labels (proposed):** Add `Menu`, `RAC`, `accessibility`, `needs investigation`, `ai-reviewed`; recommend `ready for review` for a maintainer to apply. Remove none. All exist.
- **Maintainer next step:** Ready for investigation from the supplied steps, versions, browser/OS information and linked repro. Verify immediate focus return and suppression of stale item actions for both action and link items during exit; preserve normal focus restoration. No existing API-only fix or verified workaround was established.

### [#10941: Menu: Tab does nothing in an open Menu (MenuTrigger + Popover)](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10941)

- **Problem:** **High severity:** forward and reverse Tab fail to leave the modal Menu, blocking expected keyboard navigation: "After Tab, focus stays on item A and the menu stays open. Shift+Tab does the same." Escape is a separate dismissal path, so this is not evidence that every keyboard exit is blocked.
- **Concerns / notes:** Same versions and browser/OS coverage as #10943, with clear steps and a linked StackBlitz, unvisited. There is independent historical support for the expected behaviour: a [maintainer comment on #3298](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/3298#issuecomment-1182015269) says Tab should "move focus out of the menu ... and close all menus", and merged [#295](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/295) added "automatically closing menus and moving focus ... when tabbing out". #3298 requested Tab navigation *between items*, not this failure, so it is not a duplicate. #295 is historical intent, not proof this modern composition worked in a specific release.
- **Concerns / notes:** Main enables Popover containment ([Popover.tsx, lines 376-379](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria-components/src/Popover.tsx#L376-L379)); FocusScope's containing path prevents default Tab ([lines 377-395](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria/src/focus/FocusScope.tsx#L377-L395)), while its restoration-based Tab listener is installed only when `!contain` ([lines 753-760](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria/src/focus/FocusScope.tsx#L753-L760)). This is an investigation lead, not runtime confirmation. No supported duplicate or current fix found.
- **Labels (proposed):** Add `Menu`, `RAC`, `accessibility`, `needs investigation`, `ai-reviewed`; recommend `ready for review` for a maintainer to apply. Remove none. All exist. Do not label `regression` without a working-version comparison.
- **Maintainer next step:** Ready for investigation. Verify Tab and Shift+Tab dismissal and destinations with focusable elements before and after the trigger, including submenus. Do not recommend disabling modal focus management or an app-level keyboard interception hack as a fix.

> **Would have done**
>
> Proposed labels only, with `ready for review` left to maintainers. Retained this as distinct from the animation reports and #3298; no duplicate notice. Actual GitHub actions: none.

### [#10942: Menu: a Menu reopened during its exit animation does not take focus](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10942)

- **Problem:** **Medium severity, accessibility impact:** rapid close/reopen leaves a visible Menu without keyboard operation: "`document.activeElement` is `<body>`. Arrow keys and Escape do nothing." The trigger can be operated with the pointer, but keyboard recovery is not demonstrated.
- **Concerns / notes:** Same reported versions, environments and linked, unvisited StackBlitz as the other Menu reports; exact steps specify reopening within a 300 ms exit. Main preserves the exiting Popover ([lines 201-203](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria-components/src/Popover.tsx#L201-L203)); Menu trigger props supply autofocus ([useMenuTrigger.ts, lines 202-206](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria/src/menu/useMenuTrigger.ts#L202-L206)), but collection autofocus clears its internal flag after items exist ([useSelectableCollection.ts, lines 610-655](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria/src/selection/useSelectableCollection.ts#L610-L655)). Check retained-instance reopening, rather than assuming ordinary mount autofocus runs again.
- **Concerns / notes:** No supported duplicate or fixing PR found. [#10448](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10448) concerns pointer-leave focus and explicitly says closing-transition flashing is "a separate bug"; it does not establish a fix for reopening. #10593 requires two sibling overlays, unlike the single reopened Menu here. No earlier working version or verified API-only workaround.
- **Labels (proposed):** Add `Menu`, `RAC`, `accessibility`, `needs investigation`, `ai-reviewed`; recommend `ready for review` for a maintainer to apply. Remove none. All exist; no `regression`.
- **Maintainer next step:** Ready for investigation from the reported steps and environment. Verify focus and keyboard dismissal when reopening before versus after exit completion, using pointer and keyboard opening, alongside #10943. Root cause remains uncertain until reproduced.

### [#10940: Declare @types/react as an optional peer dependency](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10940)

- **Problem:** **Medium severity:** TypeScript consumers using pnpm's global virtual store reportedly lose React types: "TypeScript picks the untyped `react/index.js` and every React type in these declarations silently becomes `any`", causing implicit-any errors and missing props.
- **Concerns / notes:** The report supplies pnpm 12.18.0, four exact library versions, a minimal command sequence and resolution trace, but not the TypeScript version or OS. Commands were read, never executed. Main corroborates the manifest omission in [RAC](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria-components/package.json#L72-L75), [hooks](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-aria/package.json#L61-L64), [state](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/react-stately/package.json#L48-L50) and [shared types](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/@react-types/shared/package.json#L17-L19); it does not independently verify pnpm/TypeScript resolution.
- **Concerns / notes:** No supported duplicate or fixing PR found. Closed [#2188](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/2188) is about React/ReactDOM peer forwarding; closed [#8777](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/8777) is about duplicate internal package versions, not missing React type peers. The author suggests `addMissingPeerTypes` or `packageExtensions`; these are unverified issue-supplied workarounds, not source/docs-backed solutions, so no `has workaround` label or suggested configuration is endorsed.
- **Labels (proposed):** Add `typescript`, `Build Infra`, `RAC`, `needs investigation`, `ai-reviewed`; recommend `ready for review` for a maintainer to apply. Remove none. All exist. No evidence of a regression.
- **Maintainer next step:** Ready for initial packaging investigation from the minimal reproduction and corroborating manifests. Confirm with a maintainer-controlled fixture; collect exact TypeScript version, OS and compiler configuration if resolution differs. Review optional type peers and their version range across all four packages, preserving JavaScript-only installs. No source-backed consumer API answer was established; do not close as misuse.
